rows.text: There was a small wooden box on the table.
Her grandfather Ben sat by the window.
Its lid was shut tight.
A brass latch kept it shut.
A flag at the window hung still.
Mara wanted to open the box.
She pushed the flag hard.
The flag swung and hung still again.
"What keeps the lid shut?" Mara asked Ben.
"The latch holds it shut," Ben said.

Mara felt anxious about the latch.

Mara felt sad about the latch.
She pressed the lid.

Then Mara pressed the lid again.
The lid did not move.
Mara pushed the latch hard.
The latch snapped back into place.
Mara was delighted with the latch.
Then she pushed the latch hard again.
The latch gave way.
Mara pushed the lid hard.
But this time the lid sprang open.
A spring inside the box uncoiled.
A toy flew out and landed on the floor.
Mara realized that Ben had been right.
She marveled at the toy.
She laughed with joy.
